scope: Demand-specific exact thermodynamic queries in native detailed reacting flow, with full mechanisms/transport and unchanged numerical controls.

method.thermal_api: GasThermodynamics contains actual thermal data, with no zero-filled kinetic fields. Full chemistry source remains in properties().
method.state_reuse: Only bitwise identical density, internal-energy density and every species density reuse the last successful phase restoration; no approximate key, property table, concentration floor or interpolation.
method.invalidation: Before a different restore attempt, direct T/p/Y setter, or shared-phase reactor integration. Failed mutation cannot retain an old valid key.
method.input_fix: Finite conserved density and energy can produce infinite specific energy on division. Reject that overflow before the inversion allowance can become infinite.

limits: A/B/B/A cold-case order reduces order bias but does not prove exclusive machine use.
Whole native process costs include construction, mesh, integration and output. Python audit cost is reported separately by each runner.
Single-case performance does not imply a general speedup, long-term flame accuracy, or a qualified combustor.
Only elapsed-time metadata is excluded from full-field equality. Physical fields, controls, sources, fluxes and integration counts match exactly in the compared cases.
Native full property/transport/reactor stdout is byte-identical for hydrogen 1100 K / 1 ms, full GRI-Mech 3.0 methane 1400 K / 2 ms, and the original hydrogen NASA7 join probe at 999.9999 K.
Existing independent reader checks numerical consistency and conservation, not experimental combustion accuracy; no new threshold was introduced.
This optimization does not resolve the observed nonstationary flame profile or establish long-time, general geometry, turbulent/spray/radiative, App or cross-platform combustion qualification.
